title: Sections of a sheaf over a disjoint union of two opens
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $\mathcal F$ a sheaf of rings on $X$, and $U,V\subseteq X$ open with $U\cap V=\emptyset$. Then the map $\mathcal F(U\cup V)\to\mathcal F(U)\times\mathcal F(V)$, $s\mapsto(s|_U,s|_V)$, is an isomorphism of rings (onto the product ring). In particular, for a scheme $X$ and an open and closed $U\subseteq X$, $\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)\to\mathcal O_X(U)\times\mathcal O_X(X\setminus U)$ is a ring isomorphism.
